claim: Vienna's only 3-star restaurants in 2026 are Steirereck im Stadtpark and Amador; 2-stars are Silvio Nickol, Konstantin Filippou, Mraz & Sohn and Doubek.
quote: Steirereck im Stadtpark shines brightly with Three Stars... Amador in Vienna was awarded the MICHELIN Guide's highest distinction... Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant in the Palais Coburg, the Konstantin Filippou restaurant, Mraz & Sohn and Doubek are all in a league of their own with two stars each.

claim: Steirereck was promoted to three stars at the 2026 Austrian ceremony; was previously two-star.
quote: The Vienna restaurant Steirereck im Stadtpark – previously awarded Two MICHELIN Stars – has now made it into the top league. ... patron Heinz Reitbauer and his team, led by head chef Michael Bauböck.

claim: Vienna's official tourist board lists addresses and opening hours for the six 2- and 3-star restaurants.
quote: Restaurant Amador, Grinzingerstraße 86, 1190 Wien... Restaurant Steirereck at Stadtpark, Am Heumarkt 2a, 1030 Wien... Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant, Coburgbastei 4, 1010 Wien... Konstantin Filippou, Dominikanerbastei 17, 1010 Wien... Mraz & Sohn, Wallensteinstraße 59, 1200 Wien... Restaurant Doubek, Kochgasse 13, 1080 Wien.

claim: Steirereck's main location serves contemporary Austrian cuisine and is part of Les Grandes Tables du Monde.
quote: Austrian cuisine in a contemporary setting. ... membership in Les Grandes Tables du Monde.

claim: Steirereck ranked No. 33 on The World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025.
quote: Steirereck | The World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025 | Ranked No. 33. Chef Heinz Reitbauer has forged a unique culinary identity that is heavily research-driven, sustainable, and fundamentally Austrian.

claim: Amador, run by chef Juan Amador, sits in the Hajszan Neuman wine cellar in Döbling.
quote: Amador's Wirtshaus & Greißlerei... Relais & Châteaux... Vienna, Austria.

claim: Amador was the first restaurant in Austria to hold three Michelin stars and held them alone for over a decade until Steirereck joined; tasting menu features carabineiro, Patagonian toothfish, turbot and venison.
quote: Amador... was, after all, the first restaurant in all of Austria to receive three Michelin stars, and it held them alone for over a decade until Steirereck came along. ... carabineiro with ajo blanco, Patagonian toothfish with escabeche, turbot from Brittany with salted Wachau apricot and sweetbread, and venison with Thai curry sauce.

claim: Amador holds three Michelin stars and offers three-, four- or six-course menus; sommelier Andreas Katona; Mraz & Sohn family business approaching 30 years with a 1,040-item wine list.
quote: Vienna's first three-star Michelin restaurant (since 2019)... Three, four, or six-course menus... Sommelier Andreas Katona... Mraz & Sohn... Family business for nearly 30 years... Wine List: 1,040 items.

claim: Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant operates inside the 5-star Palais Coburg, with a wine cellar of approximately 60,000 bottles.
quote: Silvio Nickol Gourmet Restaurant... Palais Coburg... 60,000 bottles.

claim: Silvio Nickol trained under Harald Wohlfahrt, Roger Souvereyns and Heinz Winkler; the Palais Coburg restaurant won two Michelin stars in 2012 and 18/20 Gault&Millau; head chef is Florian Daube.
quote: Working alongside master chefs such as Harald Wohlfahrt, Roger Souvereyns, and Heinz Winkler shaped his distinctive style: French-inspired, creative, and precise. ... two Michelin stars in 2012 and has maintained them... 18 out of 20 points in the Gault&Millau guide... Executive chef Silvio Nickol and head chef Florian Daube.

claim: Konstantin Filippou is in Vienna's 1st district and runs a strikingly modern set menu of seven to nine courses with no à la carte.
quote: Konstantin Filippou... fine dining... seven- to nine-course set menu... Mediterranean clarity with Austrian structure.

claim: Konstantin Filippou is a Styrian with Greek heritage; first Michelin star in 2014, second in 2016; opened sister wine bar O Boufés in 2015.
quote: The restaurant opened in 2013 with its first Michelin star in 2014 and second in 2016. ... In 2015 'O Boufes' opened next to the restaurant.

claim: Konstantin Filippou tasting menu prices: 7 courses €265 (turbot)/€310 (pigeon), 8 courses €285/€330, 9 courses €350; wine pairings €135–165.
quote: 7 courses turbot: €265, 7 courses pigeon: €310, 8 courses turbot: €285, 8 courses pigeon: €330, 9 courses: €350. ... wine pairings... €135 for 7 glasses, €150 for 8 glasses, and €165 for 9 glasses.

claim: Mraz & Sohn is a Brigittenau institution run by Markus Mraz with son Lukas in the kitchen.
quote: Mraz und Sohn... Markus Mraz... Lukas Mraz.

claim: Mraz & Sohn runs a 13-course surprise tasting menu (only the ingredients revealed in advance); Gault&Millau 18.5/20; redesigned by BÜRO KLK.
quote: Mraz & Sohn is a two-Michelin-starred, Gault&Millau 18.5-point gastronomic legend... 13 small, distinctive courses... no printed menu, only a sequence of beautifully assembled surprises... redesigned by Viennese architectural studio BÜRO KLK.

claim: Doubek is chef-patron Stefan Doubek's restaurant at Kochgasse 13, 1080 Wien, opened with partner Nora Pein.
quote: Restaurant Doubek... Stefan Doubek... Kochgasse 13, 1080 Wien.

claim: Doubek's 18-course menu (10 savoury + 4 desserts plus extras) costs €300; cooking is fire-driven with Japanese-inspired precision; signature dishes include king crab with brown butter and umeboshi.
quote: The tasting menu consists of 18 courses for €300... King crab legs paired with brown butter and umeboshi stands out as particularly memorable... Theatrics are central to the Doubek experience.

claim: Stefan Doubek earned two Michelin stars in one go, in record time for so young a restaurant; he is 31 and trained as sous chef under Konstantin Filippou.
quote: Stefan Doubek in Vienna earned two Michelin stars in record time... At 31 years old... Stefan worked as sous chef at the two-starred Konstantin Filippou.

claim: Doubek's open kitchen uses four wood-fuelled fire sources and there is no conventional stove.
quote: Food is cooked using four fire sources... no stove in the kitchen.

claim: The 2026 Austrian Michelin awards were presented on 18 March 2026; Steirereck's elevation took it to the top tier.
quote: The latest Michelin stars for Vienna were presented on March 18, 2026 as part of the Austrian edition of the Michelin Guide.

claim: Steirereck dinner tasting menus run €225 (6 courses) to €245 (7 courses); wine pairing €105–120.
quote: Dinner tasting menu costs 225-245 Euro, with wine pairing available for 105-120 Euro per person. 6-course menu (225 EUROS) and 7-course menu (245 EUROS).

claim: Amador's signature menu is called HAPPY END and currently lists at €395.
quote: HAPPY END... €395.

claim: Mraz & Sohn's tasting menu sits around €166–167 in 2025.
quote: Tasting menu starts at 167 euros per person... Another source mentions 166 euros for the menu.
